corrections.reason: The printed Ge'ez scripture text on line 9 clearly reads 'ዘአነ ፡' (followed by 'ኀረይኩ ።' on line 10), not 'ዘኪያሁ ፡'.
Ink bleed on 'ሕ' caused it to be misread as 'ላ'. The proverb reads 'ያንድ ገንዘብ ሽሕ የሕዝብ' (what belongs to one belongs to a thousand/the people).

corrections.reason: The printed text clearly reads 'ዘያበርህ' (quoting the Ge'ez root word from line 22), which was transposed in Stage 1 as 'ዘበያርህ'.
The glyph has the 5th-order (ኀምስ) loop at the bottom ('ሥጋዌ' = the Incarnation, treated as feminine singular matching 'እስትትገለጽላችሁ'), rather than 3rd-order 'ሥጋዊ'.
